definition: a glass tank of water where fish are kept
description: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

en.question: What is the young man looking at?

de.answer: Er starrt zu den Haien hinauf.
de.question: Was sieht sich der junge Mann an?

es.answer: Está mirando hacia arriba a los tiburones.
es.question: ¿Qué está mirando el joven?

fr.answer: Il lève les yeux vers les requins.
fr.question: Que regarde le jeune homme ?
